messages.author: 6b07a1c656b10946
messages.subject: Month ordering
parts:
Hi, I am looking for a bar chart of temperatures by month with the name of the month in its proper order. For some reason, the month ordering I get from ggplot is incorrect. Below is a link to my dataset (very small) and the code I have been using:

icecream <- read.csv("http://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/23281950/icecream.csv")
str(icecream)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(icecream, aes(x = Month, y = Avtemp)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity")

Thanks!
Stephen

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Month ordering
parts:
icecream$Month<-factor(icecream$Month, levels=c("January", "February", "March", "April",  "May",  "June", "July",  "August",  "September", "October", "November", "December"))

R/ggplot doesn't know that they are months. If you do not want to use date objects, then you have to reorder your months as a factor.
